rules.message: No model clears the capability and policy gates.
High-consequence work requires CT and domain review.
Regulated work cannot be autonomously approved.
Sensitive or protected data requires privacy and security review.
Pricing is outside the approved freshness window.
The estimate contains assumptions that CT must confirm.
The workflow uses more than eight model calls per request.
More than twenty model calls per request exceeds the alpha control limit.
One or more deterministic evaluation cases failed.
Independent cost recomputation did not match.
No evidence-qualified model fits the stated monthly budget. Change the workload, budget, or requirements before proceeding.
